共鳴方式上，錐形設計增強了聲音的投射效果，使其在樂隊中具有良好的穿透性。相較於圓: In the way it resonates, the conical design strengthens the projection of the sound, so that it carries well in an ensemble. Compared with the warm fullness of a cylindrical drum, the conical drum sounds drier and more forceful; compared with the timpani it is a little warmer. The cords at the side give it a distinctive sense of tension and a rich range of sound: it can play a firm, forceful rhythm pattern and also fine changes of timbre, which makes it an important rhythmic and colour instrument in the orchestra.

錐形鼓是一類膜鳴樂器或鼓，其特點是鼓身邊緣呈斜坡狀。通常只有一個鼓面。定音鼓就是: A conical drum is a class of membranophone, or drum, whose body has a sloping edge. It usually has only one head. The timpani is one example. The conical drum also has cords at its side that hold the instrument's structure together.
錐形鼓起源於非洲和中東地區，是人類最古老的打擊樂器之一。考古證據表明，早在新石器: The conical drum originated in Africa and the Middle East and is one of the oldest percussion instruments. Archaeological evidence shows that people were making similar instruments for ritual and communication as early as the Neolithic. In Africa the conical drum was widely used in tribal music and religious celebration and became an important symbol of cultural identity. With trade it gradually reached the Middle East, North Africa and the Islamic world, and in the Middle Ages it spread further into Europe. European musicians improved and developed its sound quality, and it eventually became the precise orchestral instrument, the timpani. The modern conical drum plays an important part in jazz, world music and classical music, and its distinctive timbre and structural design make it an instrument that crosses cultures.

Its unusual conical structure makes the sound waves radiate upward in a focused, direct way. Its range is wide, and the pitch can be adjusted by changing where and how hard it is struck, from a deep, full low to a high, clear ring.
